title: Last Exit Diner
lyrics:
[verse]
The waitress knows my order now
Two eggs and coffee, nothing sweet
I've been driving west all evening
With your goodbye on repeat
A truck is idling by the pumps
The radio is losing range
I thought I'd need a different life
Turns out I need some change

[chorus]
At the last exit diner
I'm taking my time
The road keeps getting wider
When your hand isn't on mine
Let the whole town wonder
Let the old phone ring
At the last exit diner
I don't owe you anything

[verse]
You loved the way I stayed behind
You called it keeping both feet down
I found a pair of better reasons
On the highway out of town

[bridge]
I won't make you the villain
I won't make me the saint
I'm just tired of standing still
And calling it a place

[chorus]
At the last exit diner
I'm taking my time
The road keeps getting wider
When your hand isn't on mine
Let the whole town wonder
Let the old phone ring
At the last exit diner
I don't owe you anything

[outro]
The waitress brings my change in quarters
I leave a little more than I ought to
